storyCards.headline: Lips Of An Angel: The Breakthrough Moment
storyCards.fact:
Hinder's "Lips Of An Angel" reached #3 on the Billboard Hot 100. Hinder is an American rock band from Oklahoma City, Oklahoma, formed in 2001 by lead singer Austin John Winkler, guitarist Joe "Blower" Garvey, drummer Cody Hanson, with bass player Cole Parker being recruited in 2002 during the recording of their debut EP Far from Close.

The song peaked at #3 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 33 weeks on the chart.

Lips Of An Angel was released in 2005.
